title: Seal's SMP Forever+
description: A Vanilla+ modpack centered around adding new things to key features of the vanilla experience while also expanding that experience to different dimensions and planets. adding new bosses for late game content and items.
body: This is a modpack created in 1.21.1 for SealsBlueLagoon. It is a modpack created with the purpose to expand certain features we found enjoyable of vannilla made to enhance or expand them. The mod includes things like The Aether BossesRise and Draconic Evolution for expanded late game. You have Create with many addons for you automation while keeping it realistic and engaging. With qol mods like JEI,mini map, and AE2.
